nameEn: Manufacture of soap and detergents, cleaning and polishing preparations, perfumes and toilet preparations
description: This class includes the manufacture of soap and detergents, cleaning and polishing preparations, perfumes and toilet preparations.
includes: manufacture of detergents and washing preparations
manufacture of cleaning and polishing preparations
manufacture of perfumes and toilet waters
manufacture of beauty preparations: face creams, lotions, sun-tan lotions, make-up preparations
excludes: extraction and refining of natural essential oils, see 2029
